edges.reason: Constructor assigns the validated _masterCopy argument into the masterCopy storage slot.
Fallback unconditionally transfers execution to the master copy code via delegatecall, enabling reentrant execution in proxy storage context.
Any external caller (msg.sender) can reach the fallback and thus the unrestricted delegatecall target.

createProxy forwards its masterCopy argument into the Proxy constructor.
createProxy invokes the Proxy constructor when deploying a new proxy.

initializer is hashed into the CREATE2 salt.
saltNonce is packed into the CREATE2 salt.
The computed salt is supplied directly to the create2 opcode.
deploymentData (creation code + mastercopy) is the create2 init code.
